subject.title: feat(providers): add Qwen Cloud individual token-plan provider

question: Should production configuration be allowed to redirect authenticated Qwen Cloud cookie requests to arbitrary HTTPS hosts?
rationale: The choice sets the credential boundary for a new cookie-backed provider: unrestricted overrides are flexible for testing, while a production allowlist protects browser and manually configured sessions.

options.title: Allowlist production endpoints
options.body: Accept only known Qwen Cloud hosts in production and use an injected transport or fixture path for tests.

options.title: Retain arbitrary HTTPS endpoints
options.body: Keep the override flexibility while explicitly accepting that a bad environment value can send authenticated session cookies to a non-Qwen host.

recommendation.title: Allowlist production endpoints
recommendation.body: Accept only known Qwen Cloud hosts in production and use an injected transport or fixture path for tests.
